Privacy

How contact information is used.

Information we collect

When you use the contact form, we collect the details you choose to provide. These may include your name, phone number, email address, service interest, and project message.

Why we collect it

We use this information to respond to your request, discuss the property, arrange an estimate, and keep a basic record of the lead. We do not ask for banking details or government identification.

Storage and sharing

Form details are sent to a private Google Sheet controlled by the business. A notification is also sent to the business email account. Information may be shared with people helping respond to the project. It is not sold.

Your choices

You may call instead of using the form. You may also ask the business to correct or remove contact information, subject to legal record requirements.

Contact

Questions about this notice can be directed to (613) 912-7508.
